#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Benchmark-only call census and matched ablations, never a production optimization.

The census is untimed. Master omission changes general Ada semantics and is
restricted to generated copies of the two fixed, entry-free benchmark kernels.
Empty cleanup guards retain real cleanup when owner differs from checkpoint.
"""
import argparse
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shlex
import shutil
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys

import measure
import profile_helpers

kRoot = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
kVariants = ('control', 'control-copy', 'no-lexical-masters', 'guard-finalization',
             'guard-rewind', 'guard-cleanup', 'masters-and-cleanup')
kMasterHooks = {'__ada_master_enter', '__ada_master_activate', '__ada_master_await', '__ada_master_leave'}
kEntries = {
    'adart': {
        '__ada_task_context': '0',
        '__ada_trace_enter': '0',
        '__ada_trace_leave_context': '0',
        '__ada_finalize_to': '*owner == checkpoint',
        '__ada_array_rewind': '*owner == checkpoint',
        '__ada_array_offset': '0',
        '__ada_collection_allocate_aligned': '0',
        '__ada_collection_activate': '0',
        '__ada_deallocate': '0',
    },
    'adamaster': {
        '__ada_master_enter': '0',
        '__ada_master_activate': 'master == NULL || atomic_load(&master->activities) == 0',
        '__ada_master_await': 'master == NULL || atomic_load(&master->activities) == 0',
        '__ada_master_leave': 'master == NULL || atomic_load(&master->activities) == 0',
        '__ada_task_discard': 'master == NULL || atomic_load(&master->activities) == 0',
    },
    'adalock': {'__ada_mutex_lock': '0', '__ada_mutex_unlock': '0'},
}


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def run(command, environment):
    result = subprocess.run(list(map(str, command)), env=environment, capture_output=True,
                            text=True, timeout=90)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(str(command) + '\n' + result.stdout + result.stderr)
    return result


def instrument(source, entries):
    for name, condition in entries.items():
        pattern = r'(^[^;{}]*\b' + re.escape(name) + r'\([^;{}]*\)\n\{\n)'
        source, count = re.subn(pattern, lambda m: m[0] +
            '    __ada_profile_count("' + name + '", ' + condition + ');\n', source, flags=re.MULTILINE)
        if count != 1:
            raise ValueError('expected one definition of ' + name)
    return 'extern void __ada_profile_count(const char*, int);\n' + source


def transform(source, variant):
    if variant not in kVariants:
        raise ValueError('unknown benchmark variant')
    changes = Counter()
    lines = []
    for line in source.splitlines(keepends=True):
        match = re.fullmatch(r'    call \$(__ada_\w+)\((.*)\)\n', line)
        if match:
            name, args = match.groups()
            if variant in ('no-lexical-masters', 'masters-and-cleanup') and name in kMasterHooks:
                if name == '__ada_master_enter' and not re.search(r', w [01]$', args):
                    raise ValueError('cannot omit collection/unknown master')
                changes[name] += 1
                continue
            guarded = ((name == '__ada_finalize_to' and variant in
                        ('guard-finalization', 'guard-cleanup', 'masters-and-cleanup')) or
                       (name == '__ada_array_rewind' and variant in
                        ('guard-rewind', 'guard-cleanup', 'masters-and-cleanup')))
            if guarded:
                operands = re.fullmatch(r'l ([^,]+), l ([^,]+)', args)
                if operands is None:
                    raise ValueError('unexpected cleanup signature')
                owner, checkpoint = operands.groups()
                index = sum(changes.values())
                changes[name] += 1
                tag = '.profile.' + str(index)
                lines.extend([
                    '    %' + tag + '.head =l loadl ' + owner + '\n',
                    '    %' + tag + '.empty =w ceql %' + tag + '.head, ' + checkpoint + '\n',
                    '    jnz %' + tag + '.empty, @' + tag + '.done, @' + tag + '.cleanup\n',
                    '@' + tag + '.cleanup\n', line,
                    '    jmp @' + tag + '.done\n', '@' + tag + '.done\n'])
                continue
        lines.append(line)
    return ''.join(lines), dict(changes)


def cacheValues(build):
    values = {}
    for line in (build / 'CMakeCache.txt').read_text().splitlines():
        if line and not line.startswith(('#', '//')) and '=' in line:
            key, value = line.split('=', 1)
            values[key.split(':', 1)[0]] = value
    return values


def validateWork(build, work):
    if work == build or work == kRoot:
        raise ValueError('use a separate diagnostic work directory')
    if work.is_relative_to(kRoot) and not work.is_relative_to(build):
        raise ValueError('diagnostics cannot overwrite source directories')
    if work.is_relative_to(build) and work.relative_to(build).parts[0] in ('runtime', 'tests', 'ada', 'adac', 'qbe'):
        raise ValueError('diagnostics cannot overwrite build products')


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--build', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--work', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--suite', choices=['cleanup', 'helpers'], default='cleanup')
    parser.add_argument('--runs', type=int, default=11)
    parser.add_argument('--repetitions', type=int, default=128)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.runs < 3 or args.runs % 2 != 1 or not 1 <= args.repetitions <= 1024:
        parser.error('use an odd run count >= 3 and 1..1024 repetitions')
    if os.name == 'nt':
        parser.error('this diagnostic supports POSIX hosts; Windows assembly requires driver stack-probe preparation')
    build = args.build.resolve(strict=True)
    work = args.work.resolve()
    try:
        validateWork(build, work)
    except ValueError as error:
        parser.error(str(error))
    kernels = {name: (measure.kSources / (name + '.adb')).read_text() for name in ('blockcalls', 'allocationcalls')}
    if args.suite == 'helpers':
        for name, text in kernels.items(): profile_helpers.validateKernel(name, text)
    work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cache = cacheValues(build)
    if cache['CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE'] != 'Release':
        parser.error('a matching Release build is required')
    cc, ar = cache['CMAKE_C_COMPILER'], cache['CMAKE_AR']
    flags = shlex.split(cache.get('CMAKE_C_FLAGS', '')) + shlex.split(cache['CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE'])
    flags += ['-fPIC'] # Runtime target uses CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE.
    if any('sanitize' in flag for flag in flags):
        parser.error('do not mix sanitizer builds and profiling')
    suffix = '.exe' if os.name == 'nt' else ''
    ada, qbe = build / ('ada/ada' + suffix), build / ('qbe/qbe' + suffix)
    environment = os.environ.copy()
    for key in ('ADAC', 'QBE', 'CC', 'ADA_LIBRARY', 'ADA_RUNTIME', 'ADA_INCLUDE_PATH'):
        environment.pop(key, None)
    runtime = build / 'runtime/libadart.a'
    links = ['-pthread'] + (['-lm'] if sys.platform.startswith('linux') else [])
    archive = work / 'census-runtime.a'
    shutil.copyfile(runtime, archive)
    members = run([ar, 't', archive], environment).stdout.splitlines()
    entriesByUnit = {unit: dict(entries) for unit, entries in kEntries.items()}
    if args.suite == 'helpers':
        for name in ('__ada_master_activate', '__ada_master_await', '__ada_task_discard'):
            entriesByUnit['adamaster'][name] = 'master == NULL || !(atomic_load(&master->activities) & kMasterDependents)'
        entriesByUnit['adamaster']['__ada_task_create'] = '0'
        entriesByUnit['adart'].update({'collectionOpen': '0', 'registerAllocation': '0', 'findAllocationLocked': '0'})
    instrumented = {}
    for unit, entries in entriesByUnit.items():
        member = [name for name in members if name in (unit + '.c.o', unit + '.c.obj')]
        if len(member) != 1:
            raise ValueError('unexpected archive member for ' + unit)
        source = work / (unit + '.c')
        source.write_text(instrument((kRoot / 'runtime' / (unit + '.c')).read_text(), entries))
        obj = work / member[0]
        run([cc, *flags, '-std=c11', '-I', kRoot / 'runtime', '-c', source, '-o', obj], environment)
        run([ar, 'r', archive, obj], environment)
        instrumented[unit] = dict(source_sha256=sha(source), object_sha256=sha(obj))
    counters = work / 'counters.o'
    run([cc, *flags, '-std=c11', '-c', Path(__file__).with_name('ProfileCounters.c'), '-o', counters], environment)
    runtimeVariants = {}
    if args.suite == 'helpers':
        for variant in ('rebuilt-locks', 'no-storage-locks'):
            directory = work / 'runtime-variants' / variant
            directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            source = directory / 'adalock.c'
            text = (kRoot / 'runtime/adalock.c').read_text()
            source.write_text(profile_helpers.withoutStorageLocks(text) if variant == 'no-storage-locks' else text)
            member = next(name for name in members if name in ('adalock.c.o', 'adalock.c.obj'))
            obj = directory / member
            run([cc, *flags, '-std=c11', '-I', kRoot / 'runtime', '-c', source, '-o', obj], environment)
            original = subprocess.run([ar, 'p', str(runtime), member], capture_output=True, check=True).stdout
            if variant == 'rebuilt-locks' and hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest() != sha(obj):
                raise RuntimeError('rebuilt lock object differs; review compiler flags before timing')
            library = directory / 'libadart.a'
            shutil.copyfile(runtime, library)
            run([ar, 'r', library, obj], environment)
            runtimeVariants[variant] = dict(path=library, source_sha256=sha(source), object_sha256=sha(obj), archive_sha256=sha(library))
    census = {}
    censusSources = {}
    failureControls = {}
    driverControls = {}
    censusExecutables = {}
    workloads = {}
    for kernel in ('blockcalls', 'allocationcalls'):
        directory = work / kernel
        directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        filename, text = measure.longSource(kernels[kernel], args.repetitions)
        source = directory / filename
        source.write_bytes(text.encode())
        control = directory / ('control' + suffix)
        run([ada, '-o', control, source], environment)
        objects = Path(str(control) + '.adaobj')
        mainObject = objects / (source.stem + '.o')
        original = mainObject.with_suffix('.ssa').read_text()
        otherObjects = sorted(p for p in objects.glob('*.o') if p != mainObject)
        programs = {'control': control}
        metadata = {'control': dict(changes={}, ir_sha256=sha(mainObject.with_suffix('.ssa')),
                                    object_sha256=sha(mainObject))}
        def buildVariant(rewritten, variant, library=runtime):
            ir = directory / (variant + '.ssa')
            ir.write_bytes(rewritten.encode())
            assembly, obj = ir.with_suffix('.s'), ir.with_suffix('.o')
            run([qbe, '-o', assembly, ir], environment)
            run([cc, '-c', assembly, '-o', obj], environment)
            program = directory / (variant + suffix)
            run([cc, '-o', program, *otherObjects, obj, library, *links], environment)
            return program, dict(ir_sha256=sha(ir), object_sha256=sha(obj), runtime_sha256=sha(library))
        if args.suite == 'helpers':
            result = run([control], environment)
            if result.stdout or result.stderr:
                raise RuntimeError('driver control must validate silently')
            driverControls[kernel] = dict(executable_sha256=sha(control), object_sha256=sha(mainObject))
            # Use the same object order/link pipeline for every timed helper probe.
            control, details = buildVariant(original, 'control')
            if details['object_sha256'] != sha(mainObject):
                raise RuntimeError('recompiled control object differs from the driver object')
            metadata['control'] = dict(changes={}, **details)
        variants = profile_helpers.kVariants[kernel] if args.suite == 'helpers' else kVariants
        for variant in variants[1:]:
            if variant in runtimeVariants:
                rewritten, changes = original, {'runtime-lock-wrapper': 2}
            elif args.suite == 'helpers' and kernel == 'blockcalls':
                rewritten, changes = profile_helpers.transform(original, variant)
            else:
                rewritten, changes = transform(original, variant)
            library = runtimeVariants[variant]['path'] if variant in runtimeVariants else runtime
            program, details = buildVariant(rewritten, variant, library)
            programs[variant] = program
            metadata[variant] = dict(changes=changes, **details)
        if args.suite == 'helpers' and kernel == 'blockcalls':
            checks = []
            for index in (0, 5):
                bad = profile_helpers.faultIndex(original, index)
                outcomes = []
                for variant in ('control', 'inline-checked-offset'):
                    rewritten, _ = profile_helpers.transform(bad, variant)
                    program, details = buildVariant(rewritten, 'bad-' + str(index) + '-' + variant)
                    result = subprocess.run([str(program)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60, env=environment)
                    if result.returncode == 0 or 'CONSTRAINT_ERROR' not in result.stderr:
                        raise RuntimeError('offset failure control did not raise Constraint_Error')
                    outcomes.append(dict(status=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr,
                                         executable_sha256=sha(program), **details))
                if any(outcomes[0][key] != outcomes[1][key] for key in ('status', 'stdout', 'stderr')):
                    raise RuntimeError('offset probe changed failure behavior')
                checks.append(dict(index=index, outcomes=outcomes))
            failureControls[kernel] = checks
        # Identical QBE/object controls catch unintended transformations before timing.
        assert metadata['control']['object_sha256'] == metadata['control-copy']['object_sha256']
        for program in programs.values():
            result = run([program], environment)
            if result.stdout or result.stderr:
                raise RuntimeError('benchmark validation must be silent')
        countsProgram = directory / ('census' + suffix)
        censusObjects, censusMain = otherObjects, mainObject
        if args.suite == 'helpers':
            name, censusText = measure.longSource(kernels[kernel], 1)
            censusSource = directory / 'census-source' / name
            censusSource.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            censusSource.write_bytes(censusText.encode())
            censusBuild = directory / 'census-build'
            run([ada, '-o', censusBuild, censusSource], environment)
            objectDirectory = Path(str(censusBuild) + '.adaobj')
            censusMain = objectDirectory / (censusSource.stem + '.o')
            censusObjects = sorted(p for p in objectDirectory.glob('*.o') if p != censusMain)
            censusSources[kernel] = dict(repetitions=1, generated_source=censusText, source_sha256=sha(censusSource))
        run([cc, '-o', countsProgram, *censusObjects, censusMain, counters, archive, *links], environment)
        result = run([countsProgram], environment)
        if result.stderr:
            raise RuntimeError('noisy census: ' + result.stderr)
        census[kernel] = json.loads(result.stdout)
        if args.suite == 'helpers' and census[kernel].get('__ada_task_create', {}).get('calls', 0) != 0:
            raise RuntimeError('single-thread diagnostic unexpectedly created an Ada task')
        censusExecutables[kernel] = sha(countsProgram)
        samples = {name: [] for name in programs}
        orders = []
        for trial in range(args.runs):
            # Rotate and reverse to distribute position and temporal drift.
            names = list(programs)
            offset = trial % len(names)
            order = names[offset:] + names[:offset]
            if trial % 2: order.reverse()
            orders.append(order)
            for variant in order:
                output, elapsed = measure.command([programs[variant]], work, environment)
                if output: raise RuntimeError('noisy benchmark')
                samples[variant].append(elapsed)
        medians = {name: statistics.median(values) for name, values in samples.items()}
        workloads[kernel] = dict(generated_source=text, source_sha256=sha(source),
            kernel_sha256=sha(measure.kSources / (kernel + '.adb')), repetitions=args.repetitions,
            variants=metadata, executable_sha256={name: sha(path) for name, path in programs.items()},
            samples_seconds=samples, median_seconds=medians, execution_order=orders,
            median_absolute_deviation_seconds={name: statistics.median(abs(x-medians[name]) for x in values)
                                               for name, values in samples.items()},
            current_over_control={name: median/medians['control'] for name, median in medians.items()},
            paired_sample_ratios={name: [x/y for x,y in zip(values,samples['control'])]
                                  for name,values in samples.items()})
        print(kernel + ': ' + str(workloads[kernel]['current_over_control']), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
    report = dict(schema=1, recorded_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        description='Diagnostic-only generated QBE ablations; not production builds or correctness/performance claims for arbitrary Ada.',
        limits=['POSIX hosts only; Windows uses the existing unmodified host suite.',
                'No sampling percentages: census counters are untimed, single-thread and perturb execution.',
                'Master omission is benchmark-only, not a generally valid compiler optimization.',
                'Cleanup guards retain nonempty calls and exception checks; no exception branches are removed.',
                'Variant differences include code-generation/layout effects, not isolated helper timings.',
                'Helper-suite zero omission and storage-lock omission require the pinned single-thread corpus; not production repairs.',
                'Helper-suite census uses one kernel activation, while timed repetitions are recorded separately.'],
        source_base_revision=run(['git', '-C', kRoot, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], environment).stdout.strip(),
        suite=args.suite, driver_controls=driverControls, census_sources=censusSources, failure_controls=failureControls,
        runtime_variants={name: {k: str(v) if isinstance(v, Path) else v for k,v in info.items()} for name,info in runtimeVariants.items()},
        census_predicates=entriesByUnit, census_executable_sha256=censusExecutables, census_runtime_sha256=sha(archive),
        census_untimed=True, census_scope='Selected runtime function entries, including runtime-internal calls; empty means the recorded owner/checkpoint or zero-activity predicate.',
        build_configuration=measure.buildConfiguration(build), host=measure.hostInformation(), runs=args.runs,
        process_startup_included=True, startup_subtracted=False,
        source_sha256={str(p.relative_to(kRoot)):sha(p) for p in [Path(__file__),Path(__file__).with_name('ProfileCounters.c'),Path(__file__).with_name('measure.py'),Path(__file__).with_name('profile_helpers.py'),*[kRoot/'runtime'/f'{u}.c' for u in kEntries]]},
        build_components_sha256={str(p.relative_to(build)):sha(p) for p in [ada,build/('adac/adac'+suffix),qbe,runtime]},
        census_instrumentation=instrumented, census=census, workloads=workloads)
    (work/'profile.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Record alternating host timing samples; never turn timings into test grades."""

import argparse
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import re
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import textwrap

kSources = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'benchmarks'
kWorkloads = ['contextcalls', 'imagecalls', 'blockcalls', 'allocationcalls']
kThroughputLiveObjects = 32


def longSource(source, repetitions):
    match = re.fullmatch(r'(.*?)procedure\s+(\w+)\s+is(.*)end\s+\2\s*;\s*',
                         source, flags=re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)
    if match is None:
        raise ValueError('expected one benchmark procedure')
    context, name, body = match.groups()
    unit = name + 'Long'
    kernel = 'procedure ' + name + ' is' + body + 'end ' + name + ';\n'
    return unit.lower() + '.adb', (context + 'procedure ' + unit + ' is\n'
        + textwrap.indent(kernel, '    ') + 'begin\n'
        + '    for Trial in 1 .. ' + str(repetitions) + ' loop\n'
        + '        ' + name + ';\n    end loop;\nend ' + unit + ';\n')


def batchSource(template, liveObjects, rounds, order):
    positions = dict(fifo='I', lifo='kLiveObjects - I + 1',
                     permuted='((I - 1) * ' + str(liveObjects // 2 + 1) + ') mod kLiveObjects + 1')
    return (template.replace('@LIVE_OBJECTS@', str(liveObjects))
            .replace('@ROUNDS@', str(rounds)).replace('@POSITION@', positions[order]))


def prepareCases(work, suite, repetitions, batchSizes, batchObjects, throughputObjects):
    cases = []
    for workload in kWorkloads:
        source = kSources / (workload + '.adb')
        cases.append((workload, source, dict(kind='short', parameters=dict(repetitions=1))))
    if suite == 'short':
        return cases
    cases.append(('startup', kSources / 'startupprobe.adb', dict(kind='startup', parameters={})))
    for workload in kWorkloads:
        kernel = kSources / (workload + '.adb')
        filename, text = longSource(kernel.read_text(), repetitions)
        name = workload + '-long'
        directory = work / 'sources' / name
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        source = directory / filename
        source.write_bytes(text.encode('utf-8'))
        cases.append((name, source, dict(kind='long', parameters=dict(repetitions=repetitions),
                     kernel_sha256=hashlib.sha256(kernel.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), generated_source=text)))
    template = (kSources / 'allocationbatch.adb.in').read_text()
    batches = [(size, batchObjects, 'scaling') for size in batchSizes]
    batches.append((kThroughputLiveObjects, throughputObjects, 'throughput'))
    for liveObjects, objectCount, series in batches:
        for order in ('fifo', 'lifo', 'permuted'):
            name = 'allocationbatch-' + ('throughput-' if series == 'throughput' else '') + order + '-' + str(liveObjects)
            directory = work / 'sources' / name
            directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            source = directory / 'allocationbatch.adb'
            rounds = objectCount // liveObjects
            text = batchSource(template, liveObjects, rounds, order)
            source.write_bytes(text.encode('utf-8'))
            cases.append((name, source, dict(kind='batch', parameters=dict(
                live_objects=liveObjects, rounds=rounds, allocations=rounds * liveObjects,
                order=order, series=series, heap_pointer_table=True), generated_source=text,
                template_sha256=hashlib.sha256((kSources / 'allocationbatch.adb.in').read_bytes()).hexdigest())))
    return cases


def hostInformation():
    result = dict(system=platform.system(), machine=platform.machine(),
                  release=platform.release(), python=platform.python_version(),
                  processor=platform.processor(), logical_cpus=os.cpu_count())
    try:
        if hasattr(os, 'sched_getaffinity'):
            result['available_cpus'] = len(os.sched_getaffinity(0))
        cpuinfo = Path('/proc/cpuinfo')
        if cpuinfo.is_file():
            result['cpu_models'] = sorted({line.strip() for line in cpuinfo.read_text().splitlines()
                if line.split(':', 1)[0].strip() in ('model name', 'CPU implementer', 'CPU part')})
    except OSError:
        pass
    return result


def buildConfiguration(build):
    cache = {}
    for line in (build / 'CMakeCache.txt').read_text().splitlines():
        if not line or line.startswith(('#', '//')) or '=' not in line:
            continue
        key, value = line.split('=', 1)
        name = key.split(':', 1)[0]
        if name == 'CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE' or name.startswith(('CMAKE_C_FLAGS', 'CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS')):
            if not name.endswith('-ADVANCED'):
                cache[name] = value
        elif name in ('CMAKE_C_COMPILER', 'CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER'):
            version = subprocess.run([value, '--version'], capture_output=True,
                                     text=True, check=True, timeout=30)
            cache[name] = dict(path=value, version=version.stdout.strip())
    return cache


def command(args, work, environment):
    start = time.perf_counter()
    result = subprocess.run(list(map(str, args)), cwd=work, env=environment,
                            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
    if result.returncode != 0 or result.stderr:
        raise RuntimeError(f'benchmark failed: {args}\n{result.returncode}\n{result.stdout}{result.stderr}')
    return result.stdout, elapsed


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--ada', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--baseline-ada', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--context-probe', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--build', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--baseline-build', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--revision', help='revision used to build the current compiler')
    parser.add_argument('--baseline-revision', help='revision used to build the baseline compiler')
    parser.add_argument('--work', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--runs', type=int, default=11)
    parser.add_argument('--suite', choices=('short', 'extended'), default='short',
                        help='original kernels, or kernels plus long/scaling/throughput controls')
    parser.add_argument('--repetitions', type=int, default=128)
    parser.add_argument('--batch-sizes', type=int, nargs='+', default=[32, 512, 4096])
    parser.add_argument('--batch-objects', type=int, default=65536)
    parser.add_argument('--throughput-objects', type=int, default=4194304)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    for name in ('revision', 'baseline_revision'):
        value = getattr(args, name)
        if value is not None and not value.strip():
            parser.error('--' + name.replace('_', '-') + ' must not be empty')
    if args.baseline_build and not args.baseline_ada:
        parser.error('--baseline-build requires --baseline-ada')
    if args.runs < 3:
        parser.error('at least three alternating runs are required')
    if not 1 <= args.repetitions <= 1024:
        parser.error('--repetitions must be between 1 and 1024')
    if len(set(args.batch_sizes)) != len(args.batch_sizes) or any(
            size < 4 or size > 8192 or size & (size - 1) for size in args.batch_sizes):
        parser.error('--batch-sizes must be distinct powers of two between 4 and 8192')
    if not 1 <= args.batch_objects <= 1048576 or any(
            args.batch_objects % size or args.batch_objects < size for size in args.batch_sizes):
        parser.error('--batch-objects must be at most 1048576 and a positive multiple of each batch size')
    if not kThroughputLiveObjects <= args.throughput_objects <= 8388608 or args.throughput_objects % kThroughputLiveObjects:
        parser.error('--throughput-objects must be a multiple of 32 between 32 and 8388608')
    work = args.work.resolve()
    work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    environment = os.environ.copy()
    for key in ['ADAC', 'QBE', 'CC', 'ADA_LIBRARY', 'ADA_RUNTIME', 'ADA_INCLUDE_PATH']:
        environment.pop(key, None)
    compilers = {'current': args.ada.resolve(strict=True)}
    if args.baseline_ada:
        compilers['baseline'] = args.baseline_ada.resolve(strict=True)
    suffix = '.exe' if os.name == 'nt' else ''
    results = {}
    for workload, source, metadata in prepareCases(work, args.suite, args.repetitions,
                                                 args.batch_sizes, args.batch_objects, args.throughput_objects):
        programs = {}
        for label, compiler in compilers.items():
            program = work / (workload + '-' + label + suffix)
            command([compiler, '-o', program, source], work, environment)
            output, _ = command([program], work, environment)
            if output:
                raise RuntimeError('benchmark must validate silently: ' + workload)
            programs[label] = program
        samples = defaultdict(list)
        for trial in range(args.runs):
            order = list(programs)
            if trial % 2:
                order.reverse()
            for label in order:
                output, elapsed = command([programs[label]], work, environment)
                if output:
                    raise RuntimeError('unexpected benchmark output')
                samples[label].append(elapsed)
        entry = dict(metadata, source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                 source_file=str(source),
                 executable_sha256={label: hashlib.sha256(program.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                                    for label, program in programs.items()},
                 samples_seconds=dict(samples),
                 median_seconds={key: statistics.median(value) for key, value in samples.items()})
        entry['median_absolute_deviation_seconds'] = {
            label: statistics.median(abs(value - entry['median_seconds'][label]) for value in values)
            for label, values in samples.items()}
        entry['execution_order'] = [list(programs) if trial % 2 == 0 else list(reversed(programs))
                                    for trial in range(args.runs)]
        if 'baseline' in samples:
            entry['current_over_baseline'] = entry['median_seconds']['current'] / entry['median_seconds']['baseline']
            entry['paired_sample_ratios'] = [current / baseline for current, baseline
                                             in zip(samples['current'], samples['baseline'])]
        results[workload] = entry
        print('Measured ' + workload + ': ' + ', '.join(
            label + '=' + format(value, '.6f') + 's' for label, value in entry['median_seconds'].items()),
            file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
    probes = defaultdict(list)
    if args.context_probe:
        probe = args.context_probe.resolve(strict=True)
        for trial in range(args.runs):
            order = [0, 1, 2] if trial % 2 == 0 else [2, 1, 0]
            for mode in order:
                output, _ = command([probe, mode], work, environment)
                probes[str(mode)].append(float(output))
    builds = {'current': args.build, 'baseline': args.baseline_build}
    components = {}
    configurations = {}
    for label, build in builds.items():
        if build is None:
            continue
        components[label] = {}
        configurations[label] = buildConfiguration(build.resolve())
        for component in ['adac/adac' + suffix, 'runtime/libadart.a', 'qbe/qbe' + suffix]:
            path = build.resolve() / component
            components[label][component] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    comparison = 'current-only; no no-slowdown conclusion'
    if args.baseline_ada:
        comparison = 'paired'
        if compilers['current'] == compilers['baseline']:
            comparison = 'identical-driver harness control; not a historical baseline'
    report = dict(schema=3, recorded_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                  suite=args.suite, process_startup_included=True, startup_control_subtracted=False,
                  warmup_runs_per_program=1,
                  collector_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                  revisions=dict(current=args.revision, baseline=args.baseline_revision),
                  build_configuration=configurations, build_components_sha256=components,
                  context_probe_sha256=hashlib.sha256(args.context_probe.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if args.context_probe else None,
                  host=hostInformation(),
                  driver_sha256={label: hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                                 for label, path in compilers.items()},
                  comparison=comparison,
                  runs=args.runs, workloads=results,
                  context_probe_samples_seconds=dict(probes),
                  context_probe_median_seconds={key: statistics.median(value) for key, value in probes.items()})
    (work / 'timings.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Fixed-corpus helper probes; not compiler optimizations or general Ada rules."""
from collections import Counter
import hashlib
import re

kKernelHashes = {
    'blockcalls': 'e1ed9eddd193b088e6430f65d528a89a08196dd9622610f51b7b782426c81df7',
    'allocationcalls': 'b98226f783afe91bb42e9f1ecdca3e6710825eebc7ee0fe5a806d9c8f76b81b6',
}
kVariants = {
    'blockcalls': ('control', 'control-copy', 'inline-checked-offset', 'omit-aggregate-zero',
                   'inline-small-copy', 'inline-aggregate', 'inline-offset-and-aggregate'),
    'allocationcalls': ('control', 'control-copy', 'rebuilt-locks', 'no-storage-locks',
                       'guard-finalization', 'guard-rewind', 'guard-cleanup'),
}
kOffsetCall = re.compile(r'    (%[\w.]+) =l call \$__ada_array_offset\(l ([^,]+), l (-?\d+), l (-?\d+), l (-?\d+)\)\n')


def validateKernel(name, text):
    if name not in kKernelHashes or hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest() != kKernelHashes[name]:
        raise ValueError('helper probes require the reviewed fixed benchmark corpus')


def faultIndex(source, index):
    def replace(match):
        result, _, first, last, stride = match.groups()
        return f'    {result} =l call $__ada_array_offset(l {index}, l {first}, l {last}, l {stride})\n'
    result, count = kOffsetCall.subn(replace, source)
    if count != 1:
        raise ValueError('expected one checked offset for the fault control')
    return result


def withoutStorageLocks(source):
    for name in ('__ada_mutex_lock', '__ada_mutex_unlock'):
        pattern = r'(^void ' + name + r'\(AdaMutex\* mutex\)\n\{\n)'
        source, count = re.subn(pattern, lambda m: m[0] +
            '    if (mutex == &__ada_main_context.sharedStorageMutex) { return; }\n', source, flags=re.MULTILINE)
        if count != 1:
            raise ValueError('unexpected runtime lock definition')
    return '#include "adart.h"\n' + source


def transform(source, variant):
    if variant in ('control', 'control-copy'):
        return source, {}
    if variant not in kVariants['blockcalls']:
        raise ValueError('unknown aggregate helper variant')
    offsets = variant in ('inline-checked-offset', 'inline-offset-and-aggregate')
    zero = variant in ('omit-aggregate-zero', 'inline-aggregate', 'inline-offset-and-aggregate')
    copy = variant in ('inline-small-copy', 'inline-aggregate', 'inline-offset-and-aggregate')
    buffers = set(re.findall(r'^    (%[\w.]+) =l alloc8 16$', source, re.MULTILINE))
    changes = Counter()
    lines = []
    for line in source.splitlines(keepends=True):
        match = kOffsetCall.fullmatch(line)
        if offsets and match:
            result, index, first, last, stride = match.groups()
            low, high, size = map(int, (first, last, stride))
            if not -(1 << 63) <= low <= high < (1 << 63) or not 0 <= size < (1 << 63) or (high-low)*size >= (1 << 63):
                raise ValueError('offset probe requires bounded nonpacked nonoverflowing constants')
            tag = '.helper.offset.' + str(sum(changes.values()))
            lines.extend([
                f'    %{tag}.low =w csgel {index}, {low}\n',
                f'    %{tag}.high =w cslel {index}, {high}\n',
                f'    %{tag}.valid =w and %{tag}.low, %{tag}.high\n',
                f'    jnz %{tag}.valid, @{tag}.ok, @{tag}.bad\n',
                f'@{tag}.bad\n', '    call $__ada_raise(l $__ada_exc_constraint_error)\n',
                f'    jmp @{tag}.done\n', f'@{tag}.ok\n',
                f'    %{tag}.distance =l sub {index}, {low}\n',
                f'    %{tag}.bytes =l mul %{tag}.distance, {size}\n',
                f'    jmp @{tag}.done\n', f'@{tag}.done\n',
                f'    {result} =l phi @{tag}.bad 0, @{tag}.ok %{tag}.bytes\n'])
            changes['checked-offset'] += 1
            continue
        match = re.fullmatch(r'    call \$memset\(l (%[\w.]+), w 0, l 16\)\n', line)
        if zero and match:
            if match[1] not in buffers:
                raise ValueError('zero probe requires the fixed 16-byte stack scratch')
            # The pinned corpus writes all four scalar elements before copying.
            # This omission is not valid for arbitrary aggregates/defaults.
            changes['aggregate-zero'] += 1
            continue
        match = re.fullmatch(r'    call \$memmove\(l (%[\w.]+), l (%[\w.]+), l 16\)\n', line)
        if copy and match:
            dst, src = match.groups()
            if dst not in buffers or src not in buffers:
                raise ValueError('copy probe requires the fixed aligned stack buffers')
            tag = '.helper.copy.' + str(sum(changes.values()))
            # Read the complete source before either write, retaining overlap behavior.
            lines.extend([
                f'    %{tag}.src8 =l add {src}, 8\n',
                f'    %{tag}.low =l loadl {src}\n', f'    %{tag}.high =l loadl %{tag}.src8\n',
                f'    storel %{tag}.low, {dst}\n', f'    %{tag}.dst8 =l add {dst}, 8\n',
                f'    storel %{tag}.high, %{tag}.dst8\n'])
            changes['small-copy'] += 1
            continue
        lines.append(line)
    expected = {name: 1 for enabled, name in [(offsets, 'checked-offset'), (zero, 'aggregate-zero'), (copy, 'small-copy')] if enabled}
    if dict(changes) != expected:
        raise ValueError('fixed aggregate helper shape changed; review the diagnostic')
    return ''.join(lines), dict(changes)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Benchmark-only call census and matched ablations, never a production optimization.

The census is untimed. Master omission changes general Ada semantics and is
restricted to generated copies of the two fixed, entry-free benchmark kernels.
Empty cleanup guards retain real cleanup when owner differs from checkpoint.
"""
import argparse
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shlex
import shutil
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys

import measure
import profile_helpers

kRoot = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
kVariants = ('control', 'control-copy', 'no-lexical-masters', 'guard-finalization',
             'guard-rewind', 'guard-cleanup', 'masters-and-cleanup')
kMasterHooks = {'__ada_master_enter', '__ada_master_activate', '__ada_master_await', '__ada_master_leave'}
kEntries = {
    'adart': {
        '__ada_task_context': '0',
        '__ada_trace_enter': '0',
        '__ada_trace_leave_context': '0',
        '__ada_finalize_to': '*owner == checkpoint',
        '__ada_array_rewind': '*owner == checkpoint',
        '__ada_array_offset': '0',
        '__ada_collection_allocate_aligned': '0',
        '__ada_collection_activate': '0',
        '__ada_deallocate': '0',
    },
    'adamaster': {
        '__ada_master_enter': '0',
        '__ada_master_activate': 'master == NULL || atomic_load(&master->activities) == 0',
        '__ada_master_await': 'master == NULL || atomic_load(&master->activities) == 0',
        '__ada_master_leave': 'master == NULL || atomic_load(&master->activities) == 0',
        '__ada_task_discard': 'master == NULL || atomic_load(&master->activities) == 0',
    },
    'adalock': {'__ada_mutex_lock': '0', '__ada_mutex_unlock': '0'},
}


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def run(command, environment):
    result = subprocess.run(list(map(str, command)), env=environment, capture_output=True,
                            text=True, timeout=90)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(str(command) + '\n' + result.stdout + result.stderr)
    return result


def instrument(source, entries):
    for name, condition in entries.items():
        pattern = r'(^[^;{}]*\b' + re.escape(name) + r'\([^;{}]*\)\n\{\n)'
        source, count = re.subn(pattern, lambda m: m[0] +
            '    __ada_profile_count("' + name + '", ' + condition + ');\n', source, flags=re.MULTILINE)
        if count != 1:
            raise ValueError('expected one definition of ' + name)
    return 'extern void __ada_profile_count(const char*, int);\n' + source


def transform(source, variant):
    if variant not in kVariants:
        raise ValueError('unknown benchmark variant')
    changes = Counter()
    lines = []
    for line in source.splitlines(keepends=True):
        match = re.fullmatch(r'    call \$(__ada_\w+)\((.*)\)\n', line)
        if match:
            name, args = match.groups()
            if variant in ('no-lexical-masters', 'masters-and-cleanup') and name in kMasterHooks:
                if name == '__ada_master_enter' and not re.search(r', w [01]$', args):
                    raise ValueError('cannot omit collection/unknown master')
                changes[name] += 1
                continue
            guarded = ((name == '__ada_finalize_to' and variant in
                        ('guard-finalization', 'guard-cleanup', 'masters-and-cleanup')) or
                       (name == '__ada_array_rewind' and variant in
                        ('guard-rewind', 'guard-cleanup', 'masters-and-cleanup')))
            if guarded:
                operands = re.fullmatch(r'l ([^,]+), l ([^,]+)', args)
                if operands is None:
                    raise ValueError('unexpected cleanup signature')
                owner, checkpoint = operands.groups()
                index = sum(changes.values())
                changes[name] += 1
                tag = '.profile.' + str(index)
                lines.extend([
                    '    %' + tag + '.head =l loadl ' + owner + '\n',
                    '    %' + tag + '.empty =w ceql %' + tag + '.head, ' + checkpoint + '\n',
                    '    jnz %' + tag + '.empty, @' + tag + '.done, @' + tag + '.cleanup\n',
                    '@' + tag + '.cleanup\n', line,
                    '    jmp @' + tag + '.done\n', '@' + tag + '.done\n'])
                continue
        lines.append(line)
    return ''.join(lines), dict(changes)


def cacheValues(build):
    values = {}
    for line in (build / 'CMakeCache.txt').read_text().splitlines():
        if line and not line.startswith(('#', '//')) and '=' in line:
            key, value = line.split('=', 1)
            values[key.split(':', 1)[0]] = value
    return values


def validateWork(build, work):
    if work == build or work == kRoot:
        raise ValueError('use a separate diagnostic work directory')
    if work.is_relative_to(kRoot) and not work.is_relative_to(build):
        raise ValueError('diagnostics cannot overwrite source directories')
    if work.is_relative_to(build) and work.relative_to(build).parts[0] in ('runtime', 'tests', 'ada', 'adac', 'qbe'):
        raise ValueError('diagnostics cannot overwrite build products')


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--build', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--work', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--suite', choices=['cleanup', 'helpers'], default='cleanup')
    parser.add_argument('--runs', type=int, default=11)
    parser.add_argument('--repetitions', type=int, default=128)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.runs < 3 or args.runs % 2 != 1 or not 1 <= args.repetitions <= 1024:
        parser.error('use an odd run count >= 3 and 1..1024 repetitions')
    if os.name == 'nt':
        parser.error('this diagnostic supports POSIX hosts; Windows assembly requires driver stack-probe preparation')
    build = args.build.resolve(strict=True)
    work = args.work.resolve()
    try:
        validateWork(build, work)
    except ValueError as error:
        parser.error(str(error))
    kernels = {name: (measure.kSources / (name + '.adb')).read_text() for name in ('blockcalls', 'allocationcalls')}
    if args.suite == 'helpers':
        for name, text in kernels.items(): profile_helpers.validateKernel(name, text)
    work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cache = cacheValues(build)
    if cache['CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE'] != 'Release':
        parser.error('a matching Release build is required')
    cc, ar = cache['CMAKE_C_COMPILER'], cache['CMAKE_AR']
    flags = shlex.split(cache.get('CMAKE_C_FLAGS', '')) + shlex.split(cache['CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE'])

    if any('sanitize' in flag for flag in flags):
        parser.error('do not mix sanitizer builds and profiling')
    suffix = '.exe' if os.name == 'nt' else ''
    ada, qbe = build / ('ada/ada' + suffix), build / ('qbe/qbe' + suffix)
    environment = os.environ.copy()
    for key in ('ADAC', 'QBE', 'CC', 'ADA_LIBRARY', 'ADA_RUNTIME', 'ADA_INCLUDE_PATH'):
        environment.pop(key, None)
    runtime = build / 'runtime/libadart.a'
    links = ['-pthread'] + (['-lm'] if sys.platform.startswith('linux') else [])
    archive = work / 'census-runtime.a'
    shutil.copyfile(runtime, archive)
    members = run([ar, 't', archive], environment).stdout.splitlines()
    entriesByUnit = {unit: dict(entries) for unit, entries in kEntries.items()}
    if args.suite == 'helpers':
        for name in ('__ada_master_activate', '__ada_master_await', '__ada_task_discard'):

        entriesByUnit['adart'].update({'collectionOpen': '0', 'registerAllocation': '0', 'findAllocationLocked': '0'})

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Record alternating host timing samples; never turn timings into test grades."""

import argparse
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import re
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import textwrap

kSources = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'benchmarks'
kWorkloads = ['contextcalls', 'imagecalls', 'blockcalls', 'allocationcalls']
kThroughputLiveObjects = 32


def longSource(source, repetitions):
    match = re.fullmatch(r'(.*?)procedure\s+(\w+)\s+is(.*)end\s+\2\s*;\s*',
                         source, flags=re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)
    if match is None:
        raise ValueError('expected one benchmark procedure')
    context, name, body = match.groups()
    unit = name + 'Long'
    kernel = 'procedure ' + name + ' is' + body + 'end ' + name + ';\n'
    return unit.lower() + '.adb', (context + 'procedure ' + unit + ' is\n'
        + textwrap.indent(kernel, '    ') + 'begin\n'
        + '    for Trial in 1 .. ' + str(repetitions) + ' loop\n'
        + '        ' + name + ';\n    end loop;\nend ' + unit + ';\n')


def batchSource(template, liveObjects, rounds, order):
    positions = dict(fifo='I', lifo='kLiveObjects - I + 1',
                     permuted='((I - 1) * ' + str(liveObjects // 2 + 1) + ') mod kLiveObjects + 1')
    return (template.replace('@LIVE_OBJECTS@', str(liveObjects))
            .replace('@ROUNDS@', str(rounds)).replace('@POSITION@', positions[order]))


def prepareCases(work, suite, repetitions, batchSizes, batchObjects, throughputObjects):
    cases = []
    for workload in kWorkloads:
        source = kSources / (workload + '.adb')
        cases.append((workload, source, dict(kind='short', parameters=dict(repetitions=1))))
    if suite == 'short':
        return cases
    cases.append(('startup', kSources / 'startupprobe.adb', dict(kind='startup', parameters={})))
    for workload in kWorkloads:
        kernel = kSources / (workload + '.adb')
        filename, text = longSource(kernel.read_text(), repetitions)
        name = workload + '-long'
        directory = work / 'sources' / name
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        source = directory / filename
        source.write_bytes(text.encode('utf-8'))
        cases.append((name, source, dict(kind='long', parameters=dict(repetitions=repetitions),
                     kernel_sha256=hashlib.sha256(kernel.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), generated_source=text)))
    template = (kSources / 'allocationbatch.adb.in').read_text()
    batches = [(size, batchObjects, 'scaling') for size in batchSizes]
    batches.append((kThroughputLiveObjects, throughputObjects, 'throughput'))
    for liveObjects, objectCount, series in batches:
        for order in ('fifo', 'lifo', 'permuted'):
            name = 'allocationbatch-' + ('throughput-' if series == 'throughput' else '') + order + '-' + str(liveObjects)
            directory = work / 'sources' / name
            directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            source = directory / 'allocationbatch.adb'
            rounds = objectCount // liveObjects
            text = batchSource(template, liveObjects, rounds, order)
            source.write_bytes(text.encode('utf-8'))
            cases.append((name, source, dict(kind='batch', parameters=dict(
                live_objects=liveObjects, rounds=rounds, allocations=rounds * liveObjects,
                order=order, series=series, heap_pointer_table=True), generated_source=text,
                template_sha256=hashlib.sha256((kSources / 'allocationbatch.adb.in').read_bytes()).hexdigest())))
    return cases


def hostInformation():
    result = dict(system=platform.system(), machine=platform.machine(),
                  release=platform.release(), python=platform.python_version(),
                  processor=platform.processor(), logical_cpus=os.cpu_count())
    try:
        if hasattr(os, 'sched_getaffinity'):
            result['available_cpus'] = len(os.sched_getaffinity(0))
        cpuinfo = Path('/proc/cpuinfo')
        if cpuinfo.is_file():
            result['cpu_models'] = sorted({line.strip() for line in cpuinfo.read_text().splitlines()
                if line.split(':', 1)[0].strip() in ('model name', 'CPU implementer', 'CPU part')})
    except OSError:
        pass
    return result


def buildConfiguration(build):
    cache = {}
    for line in (build / 'CMakeCache.txt').read_text().splitlines():
        if not line or line.startswith(('#', '//')) or '=' not in line:
            continue
        key, value = line.split('=', 1)
        name = key.split(':', 1)[0]
        if name == 'CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE' or name.startswith(('CMAKE_C_FLAGS', 'CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS')):
            if not name.endswith('-ADVANCED'):
                cache[name] = value
        elif name in ('CMAKE_C_COMPILER', 'CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER'):
            version = subprocess.run([value, '--version'], capture_output=True,
                                     text=True, check=True, timeout=30)
            cache[name] = dict(path=value, version=version.stdout.strip())
    return cache


def command(args, work, environment):
    start = time.perf_counter()
    result = subprocess.run(list(map(str, args)), cwd=work, env=environment,
                            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
    if result.returncode != 0 or result.stderr:
        raise RuntimeError(f'benchmark failed: {args}\n{result.returncode}\n{result.stdout}{result.stderr}')
    return result.stdout, elapsed


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--ada', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--baseline-ada', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--context-probe', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--build', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--baseline-build', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--revision', help='revision used to build the current compiler')
    parser.add_argument('--baseline-revision', help='revision used to build the baseline compiler')
    parser.add_argument('--work', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--runs', type=int, default=11)
    parser.add_argument('--suite', choices=('short', 'extended'), default='short',
                        help='original kernels, or kernels plus long/scaling/throughput controls')
    parser.add_argument('--repetitions', type=int, default=128)
    parser.add_argument('--batch-sizes', type=int, nargs='+', default=[32, 512, 4096])
    parser.add_argument('--batch-objects', type=int, default=65536)
    parser.add_argument('--throughput-objects', type=int, default=4194304)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    for name in ('revision', 'baseline_revision'):
        value = getattr(args, name)
        if value is not None and not value.strip():
            parser.error('--' + name.replace('_', '-') + ' must not be empty')
    if args.baseline_build and not args.baseline_ada:
        parser.error('--baseline-build requires --baseline-ada')
    if args.runs < 3:
        parser.error('at least three alternating runs are required')
    if not 1 <= args.repetitions <= 1024:
        parser.error('--repetitions must be between 1 and 1024')
    if len(set(args.batch_sizes)) != len(args.batch_sizes) or any(
            size < 4 or size > 8192 or size & (size - 1) for size in args.batch_sizes):
        parser.error('--batch-sizes must be distinct powers of two between 4 and 8192')
    if not 1 <= args.batch_objects <= 1048576 or any(
            args.batch_objects % size or args.batch_objects < size for size in args.batch_sizes):
        parser.error('--batch-objects must be at most 1048576 and a positive multiple of each batch size')
    if not kThroughputLiveObjects <= args.throughput_objects <= 8388608 or args.throughput_objects % kThroughputLiveObjects:
        parser.error('--throughput-objects must be a multiple of 32 between 32 and 8388608')
    work = args.work.resolve()
    work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    environment = os.environ.copy()
    for key in ['ADAC', 'QBE', 'CC', 'ADA_LIBRARY', 'ADA_RUNTIME', 'ADA_INCLUDE_PATH']:
        environment.pop(key, None)
    compilers = {'current': args.ada.resolve(strict=True)}
    if args.baseline_ada:
        compilers['baseline'] = args.baseline_ada.resolve(strict=True)
    suffix = '.exe' if os.name == 'nt' else ''
    results = {}
    for workload, source, metadata in prepareCases(work, args.suite, args.repetitions,
                                                 args.batch_sizes, args.batch_objects, args.throughput_objects):
        programs = {}
        for label, compiler in compilers.items():
            program = work / (workload + '-' + label + suffix)
            command([compiler, '-o', program, source], work, environment)
            output, _ = command([program], work, environment)
            if output:
                raise RuntimeError('benchmark must validate silently: ' + workload)
            programs[label] = program
        samples = defaultdict(list)
        for trial in range(args.runs):
            order = list(programs)
            if trial % 2:
                order.reverse()
            for label in order:
                output, elapsed = command([programs[label]], work, environment)
                if output:
                    raise RuntimeError('unexpected benchmark output')
                samples[label].append(elapsed)
        entry = dict(metadata, source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                 source_file=str(source),
                 executable_sha256={label: hashlib.sha256(program.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                                    for label, program in programs.items()},
                 samples_seconds=dict(samples),
                 median_seconds={key: statistics.median(value) for key, value in samples.items()})
        entry['median_absolute_deviation_seconds'] = {
            label: statistics.median(abs(value - entry['median_seconds'][label]) for value in values)
            for label, values in samples.items()}
        entry['execution_order'] = [list(programs) if trial % 2 == 0 else list(reversed(programs))
                                    for trial in range(args.runs)]
        if 'baseline' in samples:
            entry['current_over_baseline'] = entry['median_seconds']['current'] / entry['median_seconds']['baseline']
            entry['paired_sample_ratios'] = [current / baseline for current, baseline
                                             in zip(samples['current'], samples['baseline'])]
        results[workload] = entry
        print('Measured ' + workload + ': ' + ', '.join(
            label + '=' + format(value, '.6f') + 's' for label, value in entry['median_seconds'].items()),
            file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
    probes = defaultdict(list)
    if args.context_probe:
        probe = args.context_probe.resolve(strict=True)
        for trial in range(args.runs):
            order = [0, 1, 2] if trial % 2 == 0 else [2, 1, 0]
            for mode in order:
                output, _ = command([probe, mode], work, environment)
                probes[str(mode)].append(float(output))
    builds = {'current': args.build, 'baseline': args.baseline_build}
    components = {}
    configurations = {}
    for label, build in builds.items():
        if build is None:
            continue
        components[label] = {}
        configurations[label] = buildConfiguration(build.resolve())
        for component in ['adac/adac' + suffix, 'runtime/libadart.a', 'qbe/qbe' + suffix]:
            path = build.resolve() / component
            components[label][component] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    comparison = 'current-only; no no-slowdown conclusion'
    if args.baseline_ada:
        comparison = 'paired'
        if compilers['current'] == compilers['baseline']:
            comparison = 'identical-driver harness control; not a historical baseline'
    report = dict(schema=3, recorded_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                  suite=args.suite, process_startup_included=True, startup_control_subtracted=False,
                  warmup_runs_per_program=1,
                  collector_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                  revisions=dict(current=args.revision, baseline=args.baseline_revision),
                  build_configuration=configurations, build_components_sha256=components,
                  context_probe_sha256=hashlib.sha256(args.context_probe.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if args.context_probe else None,
                  host=hostInformation(),
                  driver_sha256={label: hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                                 for label, path in compilers.items()},
                  comparison=comparison,
                  runs=args.runs, workloads=results,
                  context_probe_samples_seconds=dict(probes),
                  context_probe_median_seconds={key: statistics.median(value) for key, value in probes.items()})
    (work / 'timings.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))

    main()

"""Fixed-corpus helper probes; not compiler optimizations or general Ada rules."""
from collections import Counter
import hashlib
import re

kKernelHashes = {
    'blockcalls': 'e1ed9eddd193b088e6430f65d528a89a08196dd9622610f51b7b782426c81df7',
    'allocationcalls': 'b98226f783afe91bb42e9f1ecdca3e6710825eebc7ee0fe5a806d9c8f76b81b6',
}
kVariants = {
    'blockcalls': ('control', 'control-copy', 'inline-checked-offset', 'inline-aggregate-zero', 'omit-aggregate-zero',
                   'inline-small-copy', 'inline-aggregate', 'inline-offset-and-aggregate'),
    'allocationcalls': ('control', 'control-copy', 'rebuilt-locks', 'no-storage-locks',
                       'guard-finalization', 'guard-rewind', 'guard-cleanup'),
}
kOffsetCall = re.compile(r'    (%[\w.]+) =l call \$__ada_array_offset\(l ([^,]+), l (-?\d+), l (-?\d+), l (-?\d+)\)\n')


def validateKernel(name, text):
    if name not in kKernelHashes or hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest() != kKernelHashes[name]:
        raise ValueError('helper probes require the reviewed fixed benchmark corpus')


def faultIndex(source, index):
    def replace(match):
        result, _, first, last, stride = match.groups()
        return f'    {result} =l call $__ada_array_offset(l {index}, l {first}, l {last}, l {stride})\n'
    result, count = kOffsetCall.subn(replace, source)
    if count != 1:
        raise ValueError('expected one checked offset for the fault control')
    return result


def withoutStorageLocks(source):
    for name in ('__ada_mutex_lock', '__ada_mutex_unlock'):
        pattern = r'(^void ' + name + r'\(AdaMutex\* mutex\)\n\{\n)'
        source, count = re.subn(pattern, lambda m: m[0] +
            '    if (mutex == &__ada_main_context.sharedStorageMutex) { return; }\n', source, flags=re.MULTILINE)
        if count != 1:
            raise ValueError('unexpected runtime lock definition')
    return '#include "adart.h"\n' + source


def transform(source, variant):
    if variant in ('control', 'control-copy'):
        return source, {}
    if variant not in kVariants['blockcalls']:
        raise ValueError('unknown aggregate helper variant')
    offsets = variant in ('inline-checked-offset', 'inline-offset-and-aggregate')
    zero = variant in ('omit-aggregate-zero', 'inline-aggregate', 'inline-offset-and-aggregate')
    copy = variant in ('inline-small-copy', 'inline-aggregate', 'inline-offset-and-aggregate')
    buffers = set(re.findall(r'^    (%[\w.]+) =l alloc8 16$', source, re.MULTILINE))
    changes = Counter()
    lines = []
    for line in source.splitlines(keepends=True):
        match = kOffsetCall.fullmatch(line)
        if offsets and match:
            result, index, first, last, stride = match.groups()
            low, high, size = map(int, (first, last, stride))
            if not -(1 << 63) <= low <= high < (1 << 63) or not 0 <= size < (1 << 63) or (high-low)*size >= (1 << 63):
                raise ValueError('offset probe requires bounded nonpacked nonoverflowing constants')
            tag = '.helper.offset.' + str(sum(changes.values()))
            lines.extend([
                f'    %{tag}.low =w csgel {index}, {low}\n',
                f'    %{tag}.high =w cslel {index}, {high}\n',
                f'    %{tag}.valid =w and %{tag}.low, %{tag}.high\n',
                f'    jnz %{tag}.valid, @{tag}.ok, @{tag}.bad\n',
                f'@{tag}.bad\n', '    call $__ada_raise(l $__ada_exc_constraint_error)\n',
                f'    jmp @{tag}.done\n', f'@{tag}.ok\n',
                f'    %{tag}.distance =l sub {index}, {low}\n',
                f'    %{tag}.bytes =l mul %{tag}.distance, {size}\n',
                f'    jmp @{tag}.done\n', f'@{tag}.done\n',
                f'    {result} =l phi @{tag}.bad 0, @{tag}.ok %{tag}.bytes\n'])
            changes['checked-offset'] += 1
            continue
        match = re.fullmatch(r'    call \$memset\(l (%[\w.]+), w 0, l 16\)\n', line)
        if (zero or variant == 'inline-aggregate-zero') and match:
            if match[1] not in buffers:
                raise ValueError('zero probe requires the fixed 16-byte stack scratch')
            if variant == 'inline-aggregate-zero':
                tag = '.helper.zero.' + str(sum(changes.values()))
                lines.extend([f'    storel 0, {match[1]}\n',
                              f'    %{tag}.next =l add {match[1]}, 8\n',
                              f'    storel 0, %{tag}.next\n'])
                changes['inline-zero'] += 1
            else:
                # The pinned corpus writes all four scalar elements before copying.
                # This omission is not valid for arbitrary aggregates/defaults.
                changes['aggregate-zero'] += 1
            continue
        match = re.fullmatch(r'    call \$memmove\(l (%[\w.]+), l (%[\w.]+), l 16\)\n', line)
        if copy and match:
            dst, src = match.groups()
            if dst not in buffers or src not in buffers:
                raise ValueError('copy probe requires the fixed aligned stack buffers')
            tag = '.helper.copy.' + str(sum(changes.values()))
            # Read the complete source before either write, retaining overlap behavior.
            lines.extend([
                f'    %{tag}.src8 =l add {src}, 8\n',
                f'    %{tag}.low =l loadl {src}\n', f'    %{tag}.high =l loadl %{tag}.src8\n',
                f'    storel %{tag}.low, {dst}\n', f'    %{tag}.dst8 =l add {dst}, 8\n',
                f'    storel %{tag}.high, %{tag}.dst8\n'])
            changes['small-copy'] += 1
            continue
        lines.append(line)
    expected = {name: 1 for enabled, name in [(offsets, 'checked-offset'), (zero, 'aggregate-zero'), (copy, 'small-copy'), (variant == 'inline-aggregate-zero', 'inline-zero')] if enabled}
    if dict(changes) != expected:
        raise ValueError('fixed aggregate helper shape changed; review the diagnostic')
    return ''.join(lines), dict(changes)

zero_preservation_control.description: Prefill both words with all-one bits, zero via original memset or inline stores, read all 16 bytes and fail if any bit remains set. Both executables exit silently with status zero.

control.source:
export function w $main() {
@start
    %scratch =l alloc8 16
    %tail =l add %scratch, 8
    storel -1, %scratch
    storel -1, %tail
    call $memset(l %scratch, w 0, l 16)
    %head =l loadl %scratch
    %last =l loadl %tail
    %bits =l or %head, %last
    %wrong =w cnel %bits, 0
    ret %wrong
}

inline-aggregate-zero.source:
export function w $main() {
@start
    %scratch =l alloc8 16
    %tail =l add %scratch, 8
    storel -1, %scratch
    storel -1, %tail
    storel 0, %scratch
    %.helper.zero.0.next =l add %scratch, 8
    storel 0, %.helper.zero.0.next
    %head =l loadl %scratch
    %last =l loadl %tail
    %bits =l or %head, %last
    %wrong =w cnel %bits, 0
    ret %wrong
}
